name: deed.page
description: Publishes files to a permanent public URL at a slug the agent picks: static hosting for AI agents, with a native MCP server and no account required.

skills.name: Publish a Site
skills.description: Publishes a folder or files to a live, permanent HTTPS URL with one PUT or POST, at a slug the agent chooses.

skills.name: Connect over MCP
skills.description: Connects agents to a native Streamable HTTP MCP server at /mcp to publish, update, and manage sites, including custom domains.

skills.name: Serve Agent Markdown
skills.description: Stores a markdown copy of each HTML page at publish time and serves llms.txt so agents can read the site as markdown.

skills.name: Attach Custom Domains
skills.description: Attaches custom domains through the REST API and MCP and returns the DNS records to create, with no dashboard required.

skills.name: Restore Prior Versions
skills.description: Keeps version history and restore on every plan, including the first anonymous publish, with retention set by the plan.

skills.name: Sign Site Manifests
skills.description: Signs each site version with an Ed25519 manifest of paths, hashes, and sizes, and publishes the public keys at a well-known URL.
